request_payload.title: Juvenile NCL (CLN3 Disease): Emerging Disease-Modifying Therapeutic Strategies.

mentions.sentence: Caused by mutations in the CLN3 gene on chromosome 16p12, the precise functions of the encoded protein remain unclear.
